Steps for water breaks for families
What you should know comes first
Topic: Companion Animal Travel Desk water break guidance for families

Families traveling with pets need clear, calm steps at every stage, and our desk keeps the process moving. Follow the guidance below so pets, carriers, and documents are ready before the airport gets busy.

Before departure, confirm your booking details and check that the pet is approved for travel on Aurelia Skyways. Keep all paperwork in one place and review the carrier setup early. <<FACT F080>> Bring only the items allowed at check-in, and make sure the pet can stand, turn, and rest without strain. If you are traveling with a rabbit, the crate and pet must meet the weight limit for acceptance. <<FACT F064>>

At the terminal, stay with your pet unless a staff member gives a direct instruction. Use a secure leash or carrier at all times outside the approved holding area. If your pet needs water, offer a small amount only when it is safe and permitted, then close the container tightly before moving again. Do not leave food, loose bedding, or small accessories where they can spill or shift during screening.

Watch for signs of stress, overheating, or trouble breathing. If a pet seems unwell, tell the nearest agent right away so the shift coordinator can guide the next step. Do not guess, delay, or split the party without a clear instruction from staff. Travelers bringing cats, dogs, rabbits, or other accepted animals should keep documents ready in case a second review is needed.

If you are collecting a pet after arrival, move directly to the pickup point and keep the transport area clear. Report missing tags, damaged carriers, or any concern with handling as soon as you notice it. We coordinate care from booking through pickup, and fast reporting helps us protect the animal and keep the flight flow stable.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways and ask the next available coordinator.
